newsitem.title: USA: Sprint plans local service in 10 states.
newsitem.headline: Sprint plans local service in 10 states.

text.p: Sprint Corp said on Tuesday it plans to offer local telephone service to businesses in 10 states.
By offering local toll service, Sprint said it will enable business customers to receive competitive rates and volume discounts for their local toll and long distance calls all on one bill.
The first geographic regions for Sprint's local service will be Arizona, Connecticut, Illinois, Minnesota, Ohio and metropolitan New York, Sprint said.
Later this quarter, Sprint said it plans to offer local toll service to businesses in Florida, Kentucky, upstate New York, Wisconsin and Michigan.
New small business customers who choose Sprint for their long distance and local toll service can also enjoy the benefits of Fridays Free, Sprint said.
Local toll service is also available to Sprint residential customers in the same ten states, Sprint said.
